'''Steven Edmond Hurder'''<ref name="genealogy">{{mathgenealogy|4766}}</ref> is an American mathematician specializing in [[Foliation|foliation theory]], [[differential topology]], [[ergodic theory|smooth ergodic theory]], [[geometric group theory|rigidity of group actions]] and [[spectral theory|spectral and index theory of operators]].<ref name="profile">{{cite web |title=Steven Hurder|url=https://mscs.uic.edu/profiles/hurder/ |work=Staff profiles|publisher=University of Illinois Chicago Dept. of Math., Stat., & Comp. Sci.|accessdate=20 May 2024}}</ref> Hurder is a [[professor emeritus]] at [[University of Illinois Chicago]].<ref name="profile"/> Hurder was named as an inaugural fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]] in 2013.<ref>[https://www.ams.org/fellows_by_year.cgi?year=2013 List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved 20 May 2024.</ref>

==Education==

Hurder received his PhD in 1980 at [[University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign]]. His advisor was Franz W. Kamber, and the title of his dissertation was ''Dual Homotopy Invariants of G-Foliations''.<ref name="genealogy"/>

==Selected publications==

* Hurder, Steven (1981). '''Dual homotopy invariants of G-foliations''', 	Topology, 20(4):365–387.<ref>Reviews of "Dual homotopy invariants of G-foliations": Thomas E. Duchamp, {{MR|0617372}}; D. B. Gauld, {{zbl|0466.57014}}</ref>
* Hurder, Steven; Katok, Anatoly (1990). '''Differentiability, rigidity and Godbillon-Vey classes for Anosov flows''', Inst. Hautes Études Sci. Publ. Math. no. 72, 5–61.<ref>Reviews of "Differentiability, rigidity and Godbillon-Vey classes for Anosov flows": D. Savin, {{zbl|0725.58034}}; Takashi Tsuboi, {{MR|1087392}}</ref>
* Clark, Alex; Hurder, Steven (2013). '''Homogeneous matchbox manifolds''', Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. 365, no. 6, 3151–3191.<ref>Reviews of "Homogeneous matchbox manifolds": Iztok Banič, {{zbl|1285.57017}}; P. G. Walczak, {{MR|3034462}}</ref>
* Hurder, Steven (1992). '''Rigidity for Anosov actions of higher rank lattices''', Ann. of Math. (2) 135, no. 2, 361–410.<ref>Reviews of "Rigidity for Anosov actions of higher rank lattices": J. Chrastina, {{zbl|0754.58029}}; T. N. Venkataramana, {{MR|1154597}}</ref>
* Hurder, S.; Katok, A (1987). '''Ergodic theory and Weil measures for foliations''', Ann. of Math. (2) 126, no. 2, 221–275.<ref>Reviews of "Ergodic theory and Weil measures for foliations": John Cantwell, {{MR|0908148}}; L. Conlon, {{zbl|0645.57021}}</ref>
* Douglas, Ronald G.; Kaminker, Jerome (1991). '''Cyclic cocycles, renormalization and eta-invariants''', Invent. Math. 103 (1991), no. 1, 101—179.<ref>Reviews of "Cyclic cocycles, renormalization and eta-invariants": S. Bajzaev, {{zbl|0721.58049}}; John Roe, {{MR|1079841}}</ref>
